tte_retention_definition.description: Exploratory time-to-study-discontinuation endpoint definition including randomised population, origin date, event/censor date, event rule and censoring rule.

tte_retention_derivation.description: ADTTE-style derivation of one TTDISC record per randomised subject with STARTDT, ADT, AVAL, CNSR and event description traceability.

tte_retention_survival_analysis.description: Kaplan-Meier retention estimation plus exploratory active-versus-placebo log-rank and Cox summaries with proportional-hazards diagnostics.

tte_retention_tlfs.description: Exploratory retention Kaplan-Meier table and pairwise survival diagnostic table.
